## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RepositoryModule.provideWatchHistoryDatabase — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/di/RepositoryModule.kt:63-64 and app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/di/RepositoryModule.kt:68-69 (the same declaration, duplicated once per application per R15, neither following from the other)

## Trigger

Opening `WatchHistoryDatabase` through Room, on the first query issued after an install already holding a copy of `watch-history.db` at a schema version below the app's declared one — nothing observes it: the builder never installs a migration or a fallback strategy to react to it

## Today

`WatchHistoryDatabase` (core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/db/WatchHistoryDatabase.kt:9-13) declares `version = 1`. In both `RepositoryModule.provideWatchHistoryDatabase`, the builder is
`Room.databaseBuilder(context, WatchHistoryDatabase::class.java, WATCH_HISTORY_DATABASE_NAME).build()` —
no `.addMigrations(...)`, no `.fallbackToDestructiveMigration()`. By contrast, in the same files, `provideHyroxDatabase` chains `.addMigrations(MIGRATION_1_2, MIGRATION_2_3, MIGRATION_3_4).fallbackToDestructiveMigration()` on `HyroxDatabase`. Because `WatchHistoryDatabase`'s version has never changed, no installation has yet hit the missing-migration path, and the gap has produced no failure so far.

## Expected

Raising `WatchHistoryDatabase`'s version without a matching strategy on both `provideWatchHistoryDatabase` providers throws `IllegalStateException: A migration from X to Y was required but not found` on the first query issued by any pre-existing installation, while a fresh install is unaffected. The builder in both `RepositoryModule` files carries an explicit schema-evolution strategy for `WatchHistoryDatabase`, mirroring the one already written for `HyroxDatabase` in the same files, rather than relying on Room's default (which is to throw) by omission.
